notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: M1 (land animals), M2 (water mobs), M3 (night mobs) and W's w3 (the game events W's first merge left out). D0's d0b (silverfish in stone, endermites from pearls, flying navigation) is merged (c0366f3a), and release 6 is built with PROTOCOL 11 (789f6d23). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small (E3-0 names the few positional lists that are appended). Record decisions in the track log. LOAD: builds run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. Keep to the brief: each section names the commit its file:line anchors come from, so re-check every anchor before editing; keep off the hooks the M briefs own and follow the cross-area overlaps (both in E3-0). E2's e2b (44d96765) and D0's d0b (c0366f3a) are merged, so every 'waits for e2b', 'after d0b' and 'release 6 built' in the brief is met; d0b moved lines in server.rs, world.rs, walk_path.rs, entity_view.rs and families.rs, so anchors taken before it need a re-check. The orchestrator brings track-e3 up to minecraft-survival before each segment, so the review uses git diff r10-e3x-base..HEAD as usual. SEGMENT e3x: E3-16: vibration visuals, item throwers, unsourced events, projectile events and mob events. WAITS: W's w3 merged (sculk-mob-events shares mob_actions::interact with w3's leash events).

groups.prompt: Track E3 group sculk-visuals: build track-e3.md section E3-16 group sculk-visuals. Commits: 1 'Minecraft shriek rings stop under a ceiling' (sculk-3: ShriekRings::tick takes the scene and gathers boxes like poof_particles.rs:134-155; Ring::tick clips the upward move of its 0.2 box and stops on collision, then keeps fading in place; entity_view passes the scene). 2 'Minecraft vibration ripples follow the warden that hears them' (sculk-49: User::particle and VibrationView gain follow: Option<u64>; VibrationSignals resolve the mob's eye every tick through a closure from EntityView for host and friend; a ripple whose warden is gone is removed like vanilla's VibrationSignalParticle; mob_sender keeps follow; Protocol note in the log, no PROTOCOL bump).

Track E3 group sculk-thrower: build track-e3.md section E3-16 group sculk-thrower. Commit: 'Minecraft items remember who threw them, so shriekers answer the thrower' (sculk-2). Key points: ItemData.thrower (UUID) saved as Thrower in server_mobs; the client ItemEntity gains thrower; Q, Ctrl+Q and click-outside throws carry the player (host and friends), pending drops, leftovers, death drops and closed-menu returns carry none as vanilla's includeThrower false; Command::SpawnItem gains thrower; Source::Item gains the resolved thrower and player_behind returns it; an item with a thrower on a shrieker queues a step that hear_game_events adds to stepping instead of the unsupported record.

Track E3 group sculk-sources: build track-e3.md section E3-16 group sculk-sources. Commits: 1 'Minecraft containers closed by the game and buckets used on cauldrons make vibrations without a source like vanilla' (sculk-35, sculk-36: Entities::game_event_without_source beside game_event sends a new Command::GameEvent beside ChestOpeners, dispatched as level.game_event_from(event, pos, None, None); recheck_lids' lid_effects and the cauldron item use at actions.rs:1235 use it). 2 'Minecraft damage that absorption takes whole makes no hurt vibration and costs no hunger' (sculk-37: a separate damaged counter counted only when health was lost, hurt exhaustion under the same check, hurts keeps counting every hurt for the sleep wake, Steps::heard gets damaged()).

Track E3 group sculk-projectiles: build track-e3.md section E3-16 group sculk-projectiles. Commits: 1 'Minecraft mob shots make landing vibrations, and witch potions and llama spit throw ones' (sculk-19, 20, 21, 22, 41: a projectile_landed helper beside arrow_landed; shoot lines only for witch potions at witches.rs:380 and llama spit at equines.rs:624 (one line in M3's file), never in spawn_* which also load saves; NO shoot line for ghast and blaze fireballs, wither skulls or shulker bullets: fireball-trails (e3h) already posts their projectile_shoot on the first tick with HasBeenShot saved, and a second line would post it twice; the tests check that each fireball, skull and bullet flight has exactly that one shoot event and one landing; land lines beside e2b's projectile_block_hits lines for block and entity hits; an arrow a creative player turns away still lands). 2 'Minecraft dragon fireballs make vibrations and wind charge bursts are heard as their thrower's' (sculk-20 dragon part, sculk-34: projectile_game_event shoot and land for dragon fireballs with no owner; wind_burst gains the burst's owner, a player or the breeze, and posts explode as a projectile event). The ominous spawner's dispensed projectiles are W's w3.

Track E3 group sculk-mob-events: build track-e3.md section E3-16 group sculk-mob-events.
